$comment: P6.1 building archetypes: the data contract between town layout, engine (footprint, roof, collision, door, yard) and final art (Codex fills each facade id with HD illustrated art at the same width/height). Silhouette differences come from width, height, depth and roof style — never from tint alone. A building in a region may name an archetype and override any field.
